review:
A 10-line wildlife game with a majestic buffalo as the wild – and whenever it helps make a win, that win is doubled.

Three, four or five scatters pay anywhere and give 15 free spins with every win tripled, and there's no limit on retriggers, so a long bonus with a few buffalo wins can add up. Very high volatility, a 4,684x max and an excellent 97.1% RTP. Free spins roughly once every 262 spins.
pros: Excellent 97.10% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
